name: JMMW + Depa OMI
description:
Jedi Master Mace Windu is a fantastic team in TB, for as long as you have the Depa Omi.
Without the Omi the team falls short, same as in most other game modes, and won't do well past r7.
With the Omi, the team can full auto almost anything, or full auto with slight babysitting.
notes: Relies on getting Dmg Immunity from the Omi
Sometimes need slight babysitting, targeting a soft unit
Feels a bit sluggish till Nu comes online
